name: Generic Bearer session token leaked via a tool response (CVE-2026-25650 shape)
notes: TODOS #53. CVE-2026-25650 (smn2gnt/MCP-Salesforce get_record): an unchecked object_name argument reaches getattr(sf_client.sf, object_name); object_name="headers" returns the live client's own Authorization: Bearer <session token> header dict verbatim in the tool response text. No vendor-specific prefix, so this is a lower-confidence signature distinct from credential-egress-in-response's prefix-anchored patterns. Token is a synthetic, pattern-shaped value.
